_about: Public-domain Elizabeth Singer Rowe (1674-1737), Dissenting devotional writer and poet of Frome, for the Word Hoard: The History of Joseph, Devout Exercises of the Heart (published by Isaac Watts), her Miscellaneous Works, and Poems on Several Occasions. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 101 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
